name: Cai
epithet: Flame Lord of Ribeira Winds (epilogue title: Hell's-Eye)
personality: Earnest, family-devoted shonen hero from Ribeira village who fights only to save his father.
story: A 15-year-old half-human, half-god (child of the goddess Aurora, the Ice Dragon) raised in Ribeira without memories of his mother. When his father Castor is imprisoned on Cai's 15th birthday for trying to elope with Aurora, Cai enters Dagda's Heroic Games to free him. He is one of the four Flame Lords guided by Eshmel and grows into an unwilling wartime leader.

personalSkill.name: Brio
personalSkill.effect: Grants Mov+1 permanently. Lv 5 upgrade Flamekeeper: unit and nearby allies are unaffected by Underworld Flames and take half damage within them.

tierNotes: Lords excluded from KeenGamer/Pocket Tactics tiers; KeenGamer: most even growth spread of the lords (35-45% everywhere). Brio rated 5/5 by fortunesweave.co.uk.

build.role: Mounted spear and black magic lord
build.notes: Ornius Rider in Ch 5 on a Wild Ornius. Armored Ornius Rider at Lv 20 until Sense Threat is mastered, then Shaman in Ch 7 to cast every fight and reach Black Magic B (Mag 55 vs 35). Caladrius in Ch 10 (Renown 8) on the Ornius again; master Overtake. Part II: Bardinger on a horse for Aegis, Str 60 and Riding +3, back to Caladrius for Dagda in Ch 5. Part III: Orichaldia for Fierce Spear, then The Cavalier.

guide.role: Mounted spear and black magic lord
guide.summary: Your lord and first mage in Parts I and II, and a spear cavalier in Part III. Sense Threat comes from Armored Ornius Rider, Black Magic B from a short Shaman stint, then doubled black magic in Caladrius on the same Ornius. Part II's free Licenses buy a Bardinger stint that grows the Str and Riding his Part III classes need.
guide.playstyle: Hit from 1 to 2 range with Thunder, Bolganone, Lightning Strike or Blinding Starlight, then pull back on Mov 8 or more. Losing him ends the map: end every turn outside archer and anti-cavalry reach.
keys: Catch three Wild Ornius east of Dagsion in Ch 5: one to ride, two for Request to Capture Orniuses.
Take Armored Ornius Rider in Ch 6 for Sense Threat, then go Shaman from Ch 7 until Caladrius opens in Ch 10 (Renown 8): casting every fight trains Black Magic B.
Do Castor's Special Request from Pop at Renown 7 (usually late Ch 8) to unlock Caladrius.
Catch a spare horse before Part II: a Bardinger stint there trains Riding, Sword and Spear and grows Str for Part III.
Refine the Levin Sword and Star Spear and equip both before Part II.
watch: Axe C for Armored Ornius Rider is not a preferred rank: book Arena Heavy Training (it trains Spear and Axe together) from Ch 5.
Caladrius has no White Magic in class-data: Nosferatu, Seraphim and Warp wait for a class that casts it.
Whether a bond stays with the mount when you switch mounts is not documented (unverified).
Shaman is infantry with Def 25 growth: the Ornius bonus pauses until Caladrius.
Mastery speed is undocumented: every class change here waits on a condition, not a chapter.

Weight: Parts I-II Star Spear or Levin Sword 8 + Talisman Shield 3 = 11 (doubler cap 3). Part III: Star Spear +2 8 + Silver Shield 4 + Phantom Ring 3 = 15, extra 7, one over; Fierce Spear stops doubles. Not doubling? Shield off first.

Inventory: 4 to 5 core all game (spear, Levin Sword, Red Jewel, Talisman Shield, heal). Ch 7 and Ch 8: pack the Linking Rock for the Event Clash. End of Ch 12: Elixir + Concoction is his Part II stock (6/6).

guide.alt: If Black Magic reaches B at the Arena alone, skip the Shaman stint and stay Armored Ornius Rider (Def 45, mounted) until Caladrius. High Savant (Smyrnos request) keeps Black Magic and swords in Part III; pick it over Orichaldia if Cai stays your main caster.

routeNotes.note: Ride one Wild Ornius from Ch 5 and feed it every week: Paired Run gives Mov +1 at bond 3 and +2 at bond 5. With Brio (Mov +1) and Overtake (up to Mov +3) he strikes and gets back out. Get it to bond 5 before Caladrius in Ch 10.

A Magonius (Mag 65 growth in Caladrius, Paired Magic-Focus) from Headsman's Rock in Ch 12 starts a new bond; whether bonds carry between mounts is not documented, so only switch if you can feed it through Part II.

Castor's Special Request from Pop (Renown 7, usually late Ch 8) unlocks Caladrius and Aurora's Special Request from Mom (Renown 8, usually Ch 10) unlocks Dragoon for Seteth (Ch 11 or 12) and Nydine (Part II Ch 2). Mentoring is Cai's alone: no other unit is mentored.
Renown 8 gates his Caladrius exam. Deliver the crop quests as soon as the crops are ready, not on 11/27, so Renown 8 lands by early Ch 10 (end of Ch 9 at best).
Only Cai plants. Plant on every free tile from the first farm day: the route needs 20 Linaria and 90 vegetables for quests, plus the barter extras in the other units' notes.
